statement: ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ lambda.toNat → x (Reduction.e y v i) = if i = 0 then 0 else ((lambda.toNat - i + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) • Reduction.e y v (i - 1)
proof:
intro i hi
by_cases hz : i = 0
· subst i
  simp [Reduction.e, h_T001.2.2.1]
· rw [if_neg hz]
  unfold Reduction.e
  rw [map_smul, h_T001.2.2.2.2.2 i (by omega), smul_smul, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  have hf : (i.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero i
  have hfm : ((i - 1).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero (i - 1)
  have hfac : (i.factorial : ℂ) = (i : ℂ) * ((i - 1).factorial : ℂ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.factorial_succ (i - 1)).trans (by congr 1 <;> omega)
  rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sub hi]
  field_simp
  linear_combination ((lambda.toNat : ℂ) - i + 1) * hfac
